decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9795. Series context: trend strength 0.9888 and seasonal strength 0.5278; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.053); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.954.
